decisions.reason: The client accepts the immediately preceding proposal to use the same footer across all webpages while maintaining the landing page's dark theme.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi Stephanie,

Sorry I've been really busy but the website is now my highest priority:

3\. ok

Best,
Mark

value_updates.page_coverage: Use the same footer across all website pages.
value_updates.visual_theme: Maintain the landing page's dark theme.

decisions.reason: The landing page was already specified as dark; the source decision extends that theme to further website pages without changing the landing-page visual design.
Applying the landing page's dark theme to further pages does not change responsive behavior or breakpoint guidance.
The dashboard shell has a separate build process and its own light- and dark-mode styling requirement; the website-page theme decision does not alter it.
The source establishes a shared dark theme but does not change the existing landing-page font and button-color token preferences or require their propagation.
The shared visual-theme decision does not change the implementation stack or handoff objective.
